title: Final Capacitance Expression
description: Essential Criteria: The final expression for the new capacitance C' must be correctly stated as C' = (ε + ε0)/(2ε0)C.

title: Use of Gauss' Law
description: Important Criteria: The application of Gauss' law to derive the relationship between electric fields before and after introducing the dielectric must be correctly demonstrated.

title: Electric Field Relationship
description: Important Criteria: The relationship between the electric fields E and E' must be correctly stated as E' = K E, with K defined appropriately.

title: Potential Difference Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The calculation of the potential difference V and its modification to V' after introducing the dielectric must be clearly shown.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The units of capacitance and dielectric constant should be checked for consistency throughout the solution.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Any sign mistakes or incorrect application of the dielectric constant in the final expression will result in a deduction.
